rule.name: UnboundedWait
rule.message: Wait with a deadline: future.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS), future.orTimeout(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS).join(), latch.await(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS) or thread.join(30_000), and handle the timeout by cancelling the work or failing. This call waits with no limit, so a task that never finishes hangs this thread for good. An exception fits only code whose purpose is to wait for the work to finish, such as the main method of a command or a shutdown that joins a thread it just stopped.
